record.original_question: For a locally compact group G, how can one characterize when the Fourier algebra A(G) is pseudo-amenable and when it is approximately amenable?

evidence.quote: Question 11. How to characterize pseudo-amenability and approximate amenability for A(G)?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $G$ be a locally compact group and let $A(G)$ denote its Fourier algebra (the space of coefficient functions of the left regular representation, or equivalently the predual of the group von Neumann algebra $VN(G)$, equipped with pointwise multiplication and the predual norm).

A Banach algebra $\mathcal{A}$ is said to be approximately amenable if for every Banach $\mathcal{A}$-bimodule $X$, every continuous derivation $D:\mathcal{A}\to X^*$ is approximately inner, i.e. there exists a net $(\xi_\alpha)\subset X^*$ such that $D(a)=\lim_\alpha (a\cdot\xi_\alpha-\xi_\alpha\cdot a)$ for all $a\in\mathcal{A}$.

A Banach algebra $\mathcal{A}$ is said to be pseudo-amenable if there exists a net $(m_\alpha)\subset \mathcal{A}\widehat{\otimes}\mathcal{A}$ (called an approximate diagonal) such that for every $a\in\mathcal{A}$:
\[ a\cdot m_\alpha - m_\alpha\cdot a \to 0 \quad\text{and}\quad \pi(m_\alpha)a \to a, \]
where $\pi:\mathcal{A}\widehat{\otimes}\mathcal{A}\to\mathcal{A}$ is the multiplication map.

Give a characterization, in terms of intrinsic structural properties of $G$, of those locally compact groups $G$ for which:
(a) $A(G)$ is pseudo-amenable;
(b) $A(G)$ is approximately amenable.
artifact.status_search_result: No complete characterization (in terms of group-theoretic properties of $G$) of pseudo-amenability or approximate amenability of $A(G)$ appears in the literature. Partial results are known: $A(G)$ for $G$ compact with bounded irreducible representation dimensions is amenable; the Fourier algebra of the free group on two generators is not approximately amenable; Fourier algebras of discrete groups provide examples of (boundedly) pseudo-amenable algebras. The general characterization remains open.

status_evidence.title: Approximate and pseudo-amenability of various classes of Banach algebras (Choi-Ghahramani-Zhang)
status_evidence.snippet: Studies approximate amenability and pseudo-amenability for Fourier algebras, Segal subalgebras and l^1 semigroup algebras; the Fourier algebra of the free group on two generators is not approximately amenable.
status_evidence.claim: Partial results exist but no full characterization for A(G).

status_evidence.title: arXiv:1801.02208 (on amenability-type properties of Fourier algebras)
status_evidence.snippet: Discusses pseudo-amenability/contractibility for Fourier algebras of discrete groups, providing examples but not a full characterization.
status_evidence.claim: The characterization problem for pseudo- and approximate amenability of A(G) has only partial answers.
